about: Bought parts of hardware 6.4 (chassis 6.4 and electronics module case 1.0) in English, Italian and German. Rendered by site/bom.py into docs/BOM.md and the site page parts/. Each group belongs to one product. Each 'match' lists items of the bought-parts list of the print package (plates/summary.json, bought_parts, per product): their quantities must add up to the item's qty. Items without 'match' are not in the design data.

note.en: The dispenser itself: mechanics, servo bay and the holder for the module.
note.it: Il distributore vero e proprio: meccanica, vano servo e supporto del modulo.
note.de: Der Spender selbst: Mechanik, Servofach und der Halter für das Modul.

note.en: A sealed case that slides into the chassis from below, with its own version line.

note.en: Stainless steel throughout. In the kit the chassis and the flange set come assembled: you only need the wood screws and the cable tie.

note.de: Durchgehend Edelstahl. Im Bausatz kommen Gehäuse und Flanschsatz montiert: ihr braucht nur die Holzschrauben und den Kabelbinder.
